notes: All features measured from pdoom-pt-BR.mp3 (gapless decode), 155.600 s. HTDemucs stems generated directly from that decode, no inherited EN offset. 100 fps normalized stem/band RMS; pitchMidi = vocal YIN estimate, 0 for low-energy frames (not a note transcription). beat_track measured pulse times, extrapolated only outside detected pulse interval. Downbeat phase anchored at first chorus P(doom); sections follow pt-BR lyric boundaries. Kick/snare/hat extracted from drums; vocal events from vocal spectral flux. Beat/downbeat detection is automatic, not a musicological bar transcription.
